predicate.scope_notes: Includes: explicit airing or broadcasting of Y; Y identified as the program or show of broadcaster X; historical programming affiliation. Excludes: ownership of a network or production company alone; an ordinary press interaction or meeting; a person appearing on a program without broadcaster-program identification. Ambiguous unless resolved by case-local evidence: an incomplete program title such as Press with unresolved referent; unclear broadcaster versus guest role; program versus generic activity attachment unresolved. Programming affiliation does not imply ownership or production. Embedded title verbs such as Meet must not be interpreted as an ordinary interpersonal meeting.

rationale: Broadcaster program and title-Meet paths9 dominate; ratio comparison separate.
